period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's Q3-2017 unaudited financial statements. Plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used. TOTAL LIABILITIES (298,707.51m) is directly legible and cross-validated by summing Borrowings, Total Deposits, Subordinated Bond and Other Liabilities exactly. TOTAL SHAREHOLDERS' EQUITY (37,523.65m) is directly legible AND independently confirmed by this same filing's own Statement of Changes in Equity closing balance. total_assets is derived as Liabilities + Equity (336,231.16m); the asset-side component sum initially fell short by exactly 100,000,000 Taka, traced to a single corrupted digit in the printed Investments subtotal ('68,3s7,474,76s', i.e. a '3' that should read '4'); correcting it to 68,457,474,765 reconciles the asset-side sum to the identical total exactly, so investments_securities uses the corrected figure. PAID-UP CAPITAL: increased to 23,704,534,940 by this filing's date (a further 20% bonus on the 19,753,779,120 base, 'Bonus dividend paid for the year 2016' per this filing's own Statement of Changes in Equity) -- this had NOT yet happened as of the Jun-2017 filing (2017_Q2.json), pinning the second capital increase to Q3 2017. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2017. Net interest income (1431.19m) equals this dataset's own 2017_Q2 H1-cumulative NII (1031.25m) plus this filing's discrete Jul-Sep 2017 NII (399.94m) exactly. Total operating expenses (4342.53m) and Profit before provision (4035.90m) were not cleanly printed as single cumulative-column values but were derived via the identity chain (Total Operating Income minus Profit before Provision; Profit before Taxes plus Total Provision) -- BOTH figures are then independently CONFIRMED EXACTLY by the following quarter's own filing (2018_Q3.txt's Jan-Sep-2017 comparative column prints 4,342,529,283 and 4,035,900,955 respectively, character for character). Tax (1,000,000,000) and Total Provision (1,340,000,000) are both clean round numbers recovered via PBT/PAT and PBProvision/PBT identities respectively. eps_cumulative is calculated (source cell blank) using 2,370,453,494 shares outstanding (from the newly-increased paid-up capital). Interest income and interest paid are marked unavailable, the same persistent gap seen in every other quarter processed in this batch.
